Alex K: Heads up - NovaCorp kickoff prep. They need streaming with function/tool calls that return structured JSON, EU data residency, and CMK KMS. Also commercial wants a pricing anchor for 20 concurrent streams ~3k tokens/request.

Maria S: I can handle security questionnaire items (KMS, residency, audit artifacts). Do we have standard language for Dedicated vs Private storage locations?

Devon (SE): We have a Node streaming function-call sample that demonstrates chunked tool payloads. Will paste here.

Devon (SE): ```js
const ws = new WebSocket('wss://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream');
ws.on('open', () => ws.send(JSON.stringify({type:'start', model:'redwood-stream-1', options:{partial_tool_payload:true}})));
ws.on('message', msg => {
  // stream emits deltas; SDK reconstructs until function_call.complete === true
  console.log('delta', msg.toString());
});
```

Devon (SE): Note: set options.partial_tool_payload to true to receive incremental tool args. SDK exposes a helper that yields partials as they arrive.

Raj P: Quick pricing Q: does streaming change token billing vs non-streaming? Also want recommended Dedicated sizing for steady 20 concurrent streams at ~3k tokens each. They may burst to 40.

Devon (SE): Tokens billed the same. However, Dedicated lets us tune batching/KV cache so throughput cost per token falls. For baseline: recommend running a 20x3k load test. Rough ballpark for medium model: reserve 3	6 GPU-equivalents for steady 20 streams, with headroom for bursts (or use autoscale + burst pool). I'll produce a rough capacity calc after test.

Maria S: Boilerplate draft for questionnaire: "For Dedicated and Private deployments, customer data and inference payloads remain in the customer's chosen region/VPC. We support customer-managed keys via major cloud KMS providers and HSMs. Audit artifacts (SOC2, ISO) available under NDA; retention and telemetry controls configurable."

Alex K: Does the SDK buffer function_call payloads by default? NovaCorp wants to act on partial args as they stream in.

Devon (SE): Default SDK buffers until function_call complete. Partial mode is opt-in. Set partial_tool_payload:true or use the websocket delta stream; SDK will emit partial events. Expect a small CPU overhead for processing partials; latency to first partial is ~50-150ms depending on sequence.

Raj P: For the pilot commercial anchor (1 month Dedicated POC) can we offer a month-of-reserved credit + pilot discount?

Maria S: Sales usually offers pilot credits; propose 30% off list for first month of Dedicated POC, pending legal. I'll confirm.

Alex K: Action items: 1) Maria post finalized questionnaire language. 2) Devon share Node + Go snippets and a short perf note. 3) Raj draft pricing anchor including burst handling. 4) Book 30-min kickoff Tue 10am CET.

Devon (SE): I'll drop Go example and a mini load-test harness by EOD and open a runbook. Recommend eng-ml run quick 20x3k tokens test.

DeployBot: Runbook created: runbook://nova-poc-1793334444 (access: sales,se,security).

Maria S: I'll attach SOC2 link and KMS integration contacts once infra confirms.

Raj P: I'll draft procurement anchor and loop in finance + AM. Do we need infra support for EU Dedicated capacity?

Alex K: Loop in eng-infra if we need a spin-up in EU. Devon, ETA on snippets?

Devon (SE): ETA EOD today for snippets + harness.

Alex K: Thanks team. I'll send invite and include this thread in the kickoff doc: https://short.link/nova-kickoff. :thumbsup:

Maria S: :+1: posting the questionnaire answers here when ready.

Raj P: Thanks all - assembling the price anchor now.

Devon (SE): Tip: use --sample-args in SDK sample to simulate partial tool arg arrivals during local tests.

Alex K: Closing notes - we'll reconvene after runbook checks. Cheers.
